visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of a dense grove of palm-like Bennettitales growing along a muddy floodplain bank. The trees form a thick, natural wall of vegetation.

visual_logic.lighting: Soft, humid, slightly hazy light suggestive of a coastal floodplain, with a warm green-grey color cast.
